At its heart, a red carpet flows like a tongue, descending from the throne's staircase to the grand door that opens to the outside world. The throne, a wooden masterpiece adorned with vivid depictions of ancient battles, is crowned with a plush red cushion where Prince Sariel reclines. Sariel is a puppet ruler placed in power by the royal advisors after his father's death; he has no interest in governing and has a sadistic and self-destructive desire to end up on the gallows at the hands of his own people.
